corrections.compiler_and_flags: Alibaba Cloud Compiler, an in-house Clang/LLVM-based compiler (per search snippet); version and flags not stated.
corrections.tradeoffs: Needs a compiler with working C++20 module support and a build system that scans module dependencies: Clang 16+ with CMake 3.28+, and import std needs Clang 18.1.2+ with the Ninja generator (Clang and CMake docs). The technique is a language feature, so there is nothing to copy except the migration approach described in the post.
corrections.caveats: Enricher: no baseline is stated (headers with or without PCH, full or incremental build); the 0.03 s import std figure excludes building the std module itself. Other projects report mixed results: Infinity halved its build time, an LLVM Discourse thread saw slower builds, and {fmt} saw no gain.
